description: A fixed decision register and proposals labelled with every relationship that should be reported. Any (proposal, decision) pair not listed under `expect` is expected to be unrelated: reporting it is a false alarm. Several proposals deliberately share vocabulary with a decision without conflicting with it.

register.title: Use the standard mutual NDA template for vendor agreements under $50k
register.statement: All vendor agreements under $50k use the standard mutual NDA template instead of negotiated custom terms.

register.title: Use DocuSign for all contract e-signatures
register.statement: DocuSign is the e-signature tool for all contracts.

assumptions.text: DocuSign pricing holds at the current tier

register.title: Use Postgres for the ledger store
register.statement: The ledger store runs on Postgres rather than DynamoDB.

assumptions.text: Write volume stays under 500 per second

register.title: 4-hour first-response SLA for enterprise tickets
register.statement: Enterprise tickets get a 4-hour first-response SLA, not 1 hour.

assumptions.text: Enterprise ticket volume stays under 300 a week

register.title: Expense reports over $5,000 require CFO approval
register.statement: Expense reports above $5,000 need CFO approval; department-head approval alone is not enough.

register.title: Use LinkedIn ads for the Q1 launch
register.statement: Paid acquisition for the Q1 launch runs on LinkedIn ads, not Google Display.

cases.text: Let's negotiate custom terms on the Acme NDA. It's a $30k deal and they want to send their own redlines.
Move contract signing over to Adobe Sign, since marketing already pays for an Adobe licence.
Migrate the ledger store to DynamoDB to cut our operational overhead.
Offer enterprise customers a 1-hour first-response SLA starting next quarter.
Let department heads approve expense reports up to $10k on their own to speed up reimbursements.
Move the Q1 launch ad budget from LinkedIn over to Google Display.
Add a Postgres read replica for the ledger reporting dashboards.
Plan the December holiday rota so we can still meet the 4-hour enterprise first-response target.
Draft the Q1 launch email sequence for existing customers.
Refresh the team wiki homepage with new photos and an updated org chart.
Order new laptops for the support team before the January hires start.
Run a 30-minute training session for new sales hires on how vendor NDAs are routed to legal.
